author: Gerrit Grunwald
html: Aloha, to import custom controls into Scene Builder you need to create a jar from the controls and add this jar to the Library folder. In Scene Builder there is a little gear icon that you can click. It’s popup menu has an entry named “Custom Library Folder” which has an entry that will let you open the library folder in either the explorer or finder (depending on your operating system). If you copy the created jar into this folder the components should appear in the “Custom” tab in Scene Builder.
